body:
Received and inspected request054e3cef plus the canonical SPIKE-710 completion/report. The 15 findings are already part of the EPIC-612 burndown; BUG2388/2392 are merged and live, BUG2391 has an independently signed implementation lane, and remaining launch/resume/containment work retains its gates. No duplicate audit or polling timer is needed; the completed spike can stay completed.
The advisor process is active. WAKE=- alone is not an idle or service-registration verdict. Current evidence does show this root registry lacks an armed wake, while the project's service file exists and implementer29 is armed; this tool environment cannot query the user systemd bus. I am inspecting the actual registration/recovery path. Queue acceptance is separate from observed delivery and mailbox acknowledgement. Explicit mailbox read refused a partial OverBudget source, so I inspected the exact owned source message read-only and replied here; I am not claiming a read receipt was persisted.
subject: SPIKE-710 received; findings already in Codex-first work
